subject: SIG: Request for release approvals, CI artifact trail, and keystore custody
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmeinc.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — release approvals, CI artifact trail, keystore custody

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Acme's SIG assessor has asked us for a compact package covering a few items for our vendor review:

- Release approval authority (who signs off on production releases and an audit trail of approvals for the past 12 months)
- CI artifact provenance: a canonical list of builds/artifacts for the last six months with checksums and the CI job IDs that produced them
- Keystore/secret custody: statement of rotation cadence, KMS usage, and proof that private keys used for signing are stored in tenant-controlled KMS or HSM (or an explanation of operational custody)

Can Redwood provide a single bundle (PDF + logs) and a short email summary we can attach to the SIG questionnaire? If possible, Acme would like the deliverables by end-of-day Tuesday (6/18) to keep our assessment on schedule.

If there are SLA or redaction concerns with raw logs we can accept redacted artifacts and a signed attestation from Redwood.

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Security Architect — Acme Inc.

[attachment: sig-questionnaire-acme-060129.pdf (PDF)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — release approvals, CI artifact trail, keystore custody

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a bundled package and a short cover summary by EOD Tuesday. Plan:

1) Release approvals: export of the release approval ledger (CSV) showing approver, timestamp, release id, and linked RFC/PR.
2) CI provenance: a tarball of CI job metadata for the requested timeframe (job ID, commit SHA, artifact checksum, artifact name) plus our checksum manifest.
3) Keystore custody: a concise PDF describing our KMS/HSM configuration for private key storage, rotation cadence, and the associated key policy excerpts. We'll include a signed attestation from our Security lead.

I'll include a note about redactions: we will redact developer emails and internal-only runbook links, but keep all audit-relevant metadata (timestamps, job IDs, checksums). If Acme needs fully unredacted logs under an NDA, we can discuss a controlled transfer.

Attaching a short checklist of items we'll produce and tentative file names. If anything else is required for the SIG questionnaire please flag today.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
redwood.com

[attachment: steph-checklist-sig-deliverables.txt (text)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG evidence request — release approvals, CI artifact trail, keystore custody

Team — forwarding Acme's request (below). Quick asks so we can hit Tuesday: 

- Jordan: can you export the release approval ledger for the last 12 months (CSV) and confirm the column set includes approver, role, timestamp, release_tag, linked PR/issue? Preferable to include RBAC role not just name. Please place the CSV on the shared Drive folder and ping when done.
- Soojin: need a tarball of CI job metadata (GitHub Actions / internal runner logs) for the past six months. We must include job IDs, commit SHAs, artifact filenames, and SHA256 checksums. If there are retention policy gaps please call out. Note: redact dev emails; keep runner hostnames.
- Karthik: can you produce the keystore custody statement and attach the key policy excerpts? Also confirm whether signing keys for release artifacts are in AWS KMS multi-account key or in an HSM controlled by Redwood, and the rotation schedule. We will ask Security to sign an attestation.

I plan to assemble the bundle, redact where necessary, and include the signed attestation. Target: compile on Monday and finalize on Tuesday morning for delivery. If any of these items will miss the timeline, tell me earliest ETA.

Thanks — Steph

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2029 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — release approvals, CI artifact trail, keystore custody

Hi Maria — attaching the package we agreed on. Summary below and notes on redactions. Full bundle available in the shared Drive link.

Summary of attachments delivered:
- release-approval-rollforward.csv — 12 month ledger with approver role, approver name (redacted to role for individual contributors), timestamp, release id, linked PR/issue id.
- ci-artifact-log-202906.tar.gz — CI metadata tarball (job_id, commit_sha, artifact_name, sha256_checksum). We redacted developer emails and internal runbook URIs.
- keystore-rotation-statement.pdf — short statement of key custody: production signing keys are stored in AWS KMS (multi-account key, restricted IAM policy), rotation cadence = annual with emergency rotation playbook; attached key policy excerpts.

Deliverables are also placed here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example (read-only link). If Acme's assessor needs an unredacted artifact set we can arrange an NDA and an SFTP transfer.

A couple of caveats and clarifications:
- The release ledger maps release ids to approver roles; for privacy we replaced individual contributor emails with role identifiers (e.g., "Release Manager"). We can provide full approver names under a specific request and reasonable purpose.
- CI retention: job-level metadata is retained for 12 months which covers your requested window. Raw runner logs older than 90 days are rotated; if you require deeper runner logs we can extract available entries but some older logs are no longer retained.

Let me know if the SIG assessor needs any additional attestations or if you'd like a short call to review the package.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 555-0198

Attachments: release-approval-rollforward.csv (CSV), ci-artifact-log-202906.tar.gz (tar.gz), keystore-rotation-statement.pdf (PDF)
